title: Rate of air supplied.
officialText:
Where all combustion air is provided by a mechanical air supply system, the combustion air shall be
supplied from the outdoors at a rate of not less than 0.35 cubic feet per minute per 1,000 Btu/h (0.034 m3/min per kW) of total input
rating for all the fuel-burning appliances located within the space. Combustion air rates shall also comply with any applicable rules of
the New York City Department of Environmental Protection. The mechanical air supply shall be sufficient to accommodate
combustion air, ventilation air, and dilution air requirements of the installation.
